title_en: Nature Masterclasses Expert Trainer-led (NMT) Live Workshops, 10–18 November 2026
summary: All members of Seoul National University, including graduate students, may voluntarily join the Nature Masterclasses Expert Trainer-led (NMT) live online workshops, which run on GoToWebinar from 10 to 18 November 2026 (nine sessions of two hours each). Participants must register separately for each workshop through its registration link or the QR code in the attachment. They then join each session through the link in the confirmation email sent after registration.
applies_to: Members of Seoul National University (such as graduate students); the notice states that anyone in the university community may attend, not only graduate students. Participation is voluntary, not mandatory.

dates.what: Workshop period, nine live online sessions of two hours each (session-by-session times are given only in the attachment)

conditions: You must register separately for each workshop you wish to attend; one registration does not cover the others.
You can join a session only through the link in the confirmation email sent after you register.
The workshops are held only online in real time (GoToWebinar); no in-person option is stated.
The detailed schedule for each session is only in the attachment, which was not read for this translation.
steps: Read the attachment (NMT 워크숍 홍보자료.pdf) for the detailed schedule of each session; its content was not read for this translation.

Register for each workshop you wish to attend, one at a time, using its registration link: Workshop 1: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/4624864123742828126; Workshop 2: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/3612392035445159259; Workshop 3: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/3294249445472840286. You may instead use the QR codes in the attachment.
Check your email for the confirmation message sent after each registration.
At the session time, join the live workshop through the link in that confirmation email.
translation:
Title: Notice of the Nature Masterclasses Expert Trainer-led (NMT) Programme (Tuesday 10 November – Wednesday 18 November)

To strengthen the research skills of graduate students, the Undergraduate College [학부대학] (BK21 Graduate School Innovation Project) is running the "Nature Masterclasses Expert Trainer-led (NMT) Live Workshop" as set out below. We are informed that this workshop is open not only to graduate students but to any member of Seoul National University, so interested students are encouraged to take part.

A. Programme: Nature Masterclasses Expert Trainer-led (NMT) Live Workshop

B. Eligible participants: Members of Seoul National University (graduate students, etc.)

C. Schedule: Tuesday 10 November 2026 – Wednesday 18 November 2026, nine sessions in total (two hours per session)
※ See the attachment for the detailed schedule of each session.

D. Format: Live online (GoToWebinar)

E. How to apply: Register individually through each workshop's registration link or through the QR code in the attachment.
1) Workshop 1: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/4624864123742828126
2) Workshop 2: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/3612392035445159259
3) Workshop 3: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/3294249445472840286
※ You must register separately for each workshop. Join the lecture through the link in the confirmation email sent after registration.

Attachment (1 file): NMT 워크숍 홍보자료.pdf (NMT workshop promotional material, 913 KB). The content of this attachment, including the QR codes and session schedule, was not read for this translation.
